privacy_policy: Teaching-only conditions, expected ordered tokens, IDs and opaque ordered-JSON snapshots. No raw SQL rows, timestamps, runtime identity, secrets, progress or private diagnostics.

review_summary.policy: Reuse fifteen sound and distinct existing thematic cases; no new question or link writes. Bounded Ukrainian criteria distinguish grammatical alternatives from the exact target.
checks: All36 actual independently captured eligible A2/type4 snapshots reviewed under exact three direct thematic banks. Full14 attributes and every answer/options/pivots/hints/variants/link snapshot are freshly bound; original option case and repeated instances inspected.
All36 have zero hints, zero verb_hints and zero variants. The empty variants differ from accepted M67 inventory and are not substituted with assumed UK variants.

Fifteen original questions reused in the final root-selected order; no shortage, new question, missing link or old payload mutation needed. Technical question.category_id is7; Page category is52. They are different bindings and are not conflated.

Degrees five cover analytical adjective superlative most careful, easier spelling, safer ending, adverb earlier and adjective better at maths. No syllable-count universal or the-alone degree classifier introduced.

Comparative five cover two explicit item comparisons plus highest-degree selection within named group/available set/season. Reserve2650 correctly uses comparative against multiple previous versions and is not rejected by a false exactly-two rule.

Equality five cover adverb quickly, lower difficulty than impression, past clearly, adjective equality with hers and lower noise with theirs. None treats lower named degree as worse or generic inequality.

Repeated as and the are separate ordered answer instances despite case-insensitively shared option rows. Native ComposeTokenCase and mergeOptions unchanged; all selected normalized keys are grammatical without presentation overrides.

Source16254 temporal identity Today was the most exciting moment is not selected and not repaired by context. Other contextual/translation clarity exclusions are documented explicitly, not converted to global grammar bans.
No punctuation tokens exist in these original keys; reporting preserves actual native word keys rather than inventing a period token. Runtime before/after/browser acceptance remains main-owned.

clone_only_policy.notes: A finite short Ukrainian criterion is prepended to the unchanged original Ukrainian condition. No full ready English answer in prefix, shared option/token mutation, grader/normalizer changes, row/link update or SQL. Unknown/partial decoration must fail closed.
